/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: 
PROGRAMMER : Ashraf Mahmoad
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 1-4-1423 H 
*/
---------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(12); 
 H_DATE DATE ;
 V_VAL VARCHAR2(100);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 X NUMBER (7);
G_DATE DATE ;
G_DATE2 DATE ;
P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER (3);
FLAG_DT NUMBER ;
whereord varchar2(5000);
BEGIN

HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:START_DT,G_DATE) ;
HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:END_DT,G_DATE2) ;


---------------------------

IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ; 



ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;

END IF;

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT
 1
 FROM 
 dcltn_items DCLTN_JN,
 DECLARATIONS DCLTN, importers, brkr_mstr
WHERE
DCLTN_JN.PORT_CD =DCLTN.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN_JN.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN 
--DCLTN_JN.DCLTN_ISN = :P_DCLTN_ISN AND
 AND (brkr_mstr.lic_type = DCLTN.lic_type)
 AND (brkr_mstr.lic_nbr = DCLTN.lic_nbr)
 AND (brkr_mstr.port_cd = DCLTN.brkr_port_cd)
 AND (importers.port_cd = DCLTN.port_cd)
 AND (importers.impr_nbr = DCLTN.impr_nbr) AND ISD_CHK IS NOT NULL
 AND (DCLTN_DT >=:START_DT OR :START_DT IS NULL)
 AND (DCLTN_DT<=:END_DT OR :END_DT IS NULL)
 AND (ISD_CHK=:P_DCLTN_STA_CD OR :P_DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL)
 AND DCLTN.PORT_CD=P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND (DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN=:PARAMETER.p_dcltn_isn OR :PARAMETER.p_dcltn_isn IS NULL)
 )
;




------------------------------------
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN


 
 
 
 
 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 


 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ACTN_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_ACTN_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD ', TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_ISN ', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ISD_CHK', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_STA_CD); 
 


 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 

ELSE
 
MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;


END ;

pl_id ParamList;

G_DATE2 DATE ;

FLAG_DT NUMBER ;
whereord varchar2(5000);

BEGIN

HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:START_DT,G_DATE) ;
HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:END_DT,G_DATE2) ;


---------------------------

IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ; 

ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;

END IF;
------------------------------------
IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN

 
 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 


 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ACTN_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_ACTN_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD ', TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_STA_CD ', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_STA_CD); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD2 ', TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);


 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);


 
 if :P_DCLTN_STA_CD <> 5 then
 whereord :='WHERE
 SDO.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL AND
 SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD AND
 SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR AND
 SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR AND
 SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT AND
 SDO.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD (+) AND
 SDO.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.PORT_CD = L_IMP.PORT_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.AGENT_NBR = L_IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
 DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = L_BKM.PORT_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = L_BKM.LIC_TYPE (+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_NBR = L_BKM.LIC_NBR (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR is not null AND
 SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR (+) AND
 SDI.BL_SEQ = VBI.BL_SEQ (+) AND
 SDI.ITEM_SEQ = VBI.ITEM_SEQ (+) AND
 VBI.PORT_CD = VC.PORT_CD (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_TYPE = VC.MFST_TYPE (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_NBR = VC.MFST_NBR (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_DT = VC.MFST_DT (+) AND
 VBI.CNTNR_SEQ = VC.CNTNR_SEQ (+)
 AND (DCLTN.GROUP_ID = :P_GRP_ID OR :P_GRP_ID IS NULL)
 AND (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD = :P_DCLTN_STA_CD OR :P_DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL )
 AND ( TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT , ''YYYY-MM-MI'') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(:START_DT, ''YYYY-MM-MI'') AND TO_CHAR(:END_DT,''YYYY-MM-MI'') OR (:START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL))
 AND ((DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE AND DCLTN.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR )OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL)
 ORDER BY
 DCLTN_DCLTN_DT DESC' ; 
 else
 whereord :='WHERE
 SDO.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL AND
 SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD AND
 SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR AND
 SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR AND
 SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT AND
 SDO.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD (+) AND
 SDO.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.PORT_CD = L_IMP.PORT_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.AGENT_NBR = L_IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
 DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = L_BKM.PORT_CD (+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = L_BKM.LIC_TYPE (+) AND
 DCLTN.LIC_NBR = L_BKM.LIC_NBR (+) AND
 DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR is not null AND
 SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT (+) AND
 SDI.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR (+) AND
 SDI.BL_SEQ = VBI.BL_SEQ (+) AND
 SDI.ITEM_SEQ = VBI.ITEM_SEQ (+) AND
 VBI.PORT_CD = VC.PORT_CD (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_TYPE = VC.MFST_TYPE (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_NBR = VC.MFST_NBR (+) AND
 VBI.MFST_DT = VC.MFST_DT (+) AND
 VBI.CNTNR_SEQ = VC.CNTNR_SEQ (+)
 AND (DCLTN.GROUP_ID = :P_GRP_ID OR :P_GRP_ID IS NULL)
 AND (DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD = :P_DCLTN_STA_CD OR :P_DCLTN_STA_CD IS NULL )
 AND ( TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT , ''YYYY-MM-MI'') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(:START_DT, ''YYYY-MM-MI'') AND TO_CHAR(:END_DT,''YYYY-MM-MI'') OR (:START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL))
 AND ((DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE AND DCLTN.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR )OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL)
 AND VC.CNTNR_MRK NOT IN
 (SELECT VC.CNTNR_MRK
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vss,
 vssl_cntnrs vc
 WHERE ( (sdo.port_cd = dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd)
 AND (sdo.shpg_agnt_nbr = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (sdo.do_nbr = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_nbr)
 AND (sdo.do_iss_dt = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_dt)
 AND (sdo.port_cd = sdi.port_cd)
 AND (sdo.shpg_agnt_nbr = sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (sdo.do_nbr = sdi.do_nbr)
 AND (sdo.do_iss_dt = sdi.do_iss_dt)
 AND (vss.port_cd = sdi.mfst_port_cd)
 AND (vss.mfst_type = sdi.mfst_type)
 AND (vss.mfst_nbr = sdi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vss.mfst_dt = sdi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vss.bl_seq = sdi.bl_seq)
 AND (vss.item_seq = sdi.item_seq)
 AND (vc.port_cd = vss.port_cd)
 AND (vc.mfst_type = vss.mfst_type)
 AND (vc.mfst_nbr = vss.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vc.mfst_dt = vss.mfst_dt)
 AND (vc.cntnr_seq = vss.cntnr_seq)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.DGT_TYPE = 2)
 AND dcltn_gate_trans.DCLTN_ISN=DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN
 )
 UNION
 (
 SELECT VC.CNTNR_MRK
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vss,
 vssl_cntnrs vc
 WHERE ( (sdi.port_cd = dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd)
 AND (sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (sdi.do_nbr = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_nbr)
 AND (sdi.do_iss_dt = dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_dt)
 AND (sdi.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = dcltn_gate_trans.SEA_ITEM_SEQ)
 AND (vss.port_cd = sdi.mfst_port_cd)
 AND (vss.mfst_type = sdi.mfst_type)
 AND (vss.mfst_nbr = sdi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vss.mfst_dt = sdi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vss.bl_seq = sdi.bl_seq)
 AND (vss.item_seq = sdi.item_seq)
 AND (vc.port_cd = vss.port_cd)
 AND (vc.mfst_type = vss.mfst_type)
 AND (vc.mfst_nbr = vss.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vc.mfst_dt = vss.mfst_dt)
 AND (vc.cntnr_seq = vss.cntnr_seq)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.DGT_TYPE = 3)
 AND (dcltn_gate_trans.DCLTN_ISN=DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN)
 )))
 ORDER BY
 DCLTN_DCLTN_DT DESC' ;
 end if;
 

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'whereord',TEXT_PARAMETER,whereord); 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 

ELSE
 
MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;


END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_LIST_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_list_val IS
pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_BASIC_BATCHES';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, ' قائمة الاختيار للبيانات الجمركية ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .10);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DCLTN_TYPE_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 IF :GLOBAL.ADD_PAR = 1 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DCLTN_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_NBR);
 END IF;
 
 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);
 
 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR ;
 :DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_DCLTN_TYPE:=:GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 
 
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;
